en: No fiend may stand against he who slew The Fallen One.
zh: 弑落者面前，没有任何魔物可以立足。

en: The souls were too many for the Arbiter castes to erase.

en: "The cracks of pain and suffering have begun to spread in his mind. If he is lost, all of us are." -Master Dhartha
zh: 「痛苦与苦难的裂痕已开始在他心中蔓延。若他迷失，我们皆会迷失。」——达萨大师

en: When plans fail, look to the chaos for answers.
zh: 计划失败时，向混沌寻求答案。

en: "You need simply open a book and a new world awaits."
zh: 「你只需翻开一本书，新世界便在等待。」

en: The water pooled at the base of Yggdrasil offers reflections from the tree's entire lifespan.
zh: 汇聚在世界树根下的水，映出整棵树一生的倒影。

en: My blade severs both flesh and soul.
zh: 我的刃切断血肉，也切断灵魂。

en: On cloudy nights in Ogo, the stars have couriers.
zh: 在奥戈多云的夜里，星辰也有信使。

en: On cloudy nights in Ogo, the stars have couriers.
zh: 在奥戈多云的夜里，星辰也有信使。

en: His song can calm even the most restless.
zh: 他的歌能抚平最不安的灵魂。

en: The machines hum to his tune.
Instead of seeking the Temples themselves, the pathfinders sought the aid of the forest-dwellers.
zh: 寻路者不去找神殿本身，而是求助于林中居民。

en: Even the trees of Ogo have something to teach if you listen long enough.
zh: 只要听得够久，连奥戈的树木也有东西可教。

en: Even the trees of Ogo have something to teach if you listen long enough.
zh: 只要听得够久，连奥戈的树木也有东西可教。

en: The first lesson the Arha teach their young is that there will always be more lessons.
zh: 亚哈教给幼徒的第一课是：永远还有下一课。

en: Demon bone and one hundred souls.
zh: 恶魔之骨，与一百个灵魂。

en: "As others sought to hoard the shards, I sought to harness their power."
zh: 「别人囤积碎片，我则试图驾驭它们的力量。」

en: "Memory and history are no concern of mine. This foul thing should never have existed.  Now, it will be as if it never did."
zh: 「记忆与历史不关我事。这肮脏之物本不该存在。现在，它将如同从未存在过。」

en:
Find them standing on the edge of the abyss,
just beyond the jagged city.
zh:
他们立于深渊边缘，
就在锯齿之城外。

en: It lights the way to the next victim.
zh: 它照亮通往下一个牺牲者的路。

en: Heroic acts undertaken by common people make for the best tales.
zh: 凡人成就的英勇事迹，才是最好的传说。

en: Nellin observed the whirling movements of the Initiates. "Are they practicing forms?" he asked. "No," came the instructor's reply. "They are meditating."
zh: 内林注视着初学者旋转的身影。「他们在练招式？」他问。「不，」导师答道，「他们在冥想。」

en: A meditation of whirling steel and lethal clarity
zh: 旋转钢铁与致命澄明的冥想

en: "There is no self, only purpose." -- Master Dhartha
zh: 「没有自我，唯有使命。」——达萨大师

en: "There is no self, only purpose." -- Master Dhartha
zh: 「没有自我，唯有使命。」——达萨大师

en: "No Templar should die on behalf of ruffians and cowards. We will make you worthy."
zh: 「圣殿武士不该为匪徒与懦夫而死。我们会使你们配得上。」

en: "You do not see your own potential because you seek it out. It already lies within, you need only accept it."
zh: 「你看不见自己的潜能，是因为你在向外寻找。它本就在你之内，你只需接纳。」

en: "You do not see your own potential because you seek it out. It already lies within, you need only accept it."
zh: 「你看不见自己的潜能，是因为你在向外寻找。它本就在你之内，你只需接纳。」

en: Sharpen the mind, and the sword will follow.
Dhartha raised his hand to quiet the gathered emissaries, "We must not despair. The only way Nilus can grow in strength is if we lose faith in each other."
zh: 达萨举手示意使者们安静：「我们不可绝望。唯有我们彼此失去信任，尼鲁斯才会壮大。」

en: "There is nothing obscure about what is to come, Godslayer; the future is always clear to those who choose to see. It is your judgment that is clouded."
zh: 「将至之事并无隐晦，弑神者；对选择去看的人而言，未来总是清晰的。被蒙蔽的是你的判断。」

en: "Devote yourself to the Eye," Dhartha said, "and see all that the universe has to offer."
zh: 「献身于慧眼，」达萨说，「便能看见宇宙所能给予的一切。」

en:
"Born of nothing, we will return to nothing."
-Deathsworn Oath
zh:
「生于虚无，归于虚无。」
——死誓誓言

en: Anvils rang across the Dreamscape, echoing the armorsmiths' renewed inspiration.
zh: 铁砧在梦境中回响，回应甲匠重燃的灵感。

en: Fortune and choice are two sides of the same coin. The askara transcend all dualities.
zh: 命运与选择是同一枚硬币的两面。阿斯卡拉超越一切二元。

en: Doors open to those who learn to see them.
zh: 门会为学会看见它们的人打开。

en: A device meant for great discoveries.
zh: 一件为伟大发现而造的装置。

en: He speaks rarely, but all listen.
zh: 他鲜少开口，但人人倾听。

patch notes:
- fixed bug causing builder to harvest organics for material
zh:
更新说明：
- 修复建造者把有机物当材料收割的错误

en: I am Eternal. What hope have you to defeat me?
zh: 我是永恒。你们有何指望击败我？

en: Souls of the fallen fuel its eerie flame.
zh: 亡者的灵魂为其诡谲之焰添燃料。

en: The shards speak to those who have the courage to listen.
zh: 碎片对有勇气倾听的人低语。

en: Only the greatest heroes can fully harness its power.
zh: 唯有最伟大的英雄才能完全驾驭其力量。

en: "He collects souls like a ferromancer collects burns."
zh: 「他收集灵魂，如同铁术士收集烫伤。」

en: The last protector of an abandoned temple, Xeron was happy to give him a new cause.
zh: 弃寺的最后守护者——泽伦很乐意给他一个新的目标。

en: "This world is old. It has worn very thin in places." - Sadranis, Dark Emissary
zh: 「这世界太老了。有些地方已经薄得可怕。」——黑暗使者萨德拉尼斯

en: Elites are fated to be alone, for they destroy all that they see.
zh: 精英注定孤独，因为他们摧毁所见的一切。

en: They're capable of snatching victory from the jaws of pretty much anything.
zh: 他们能从几乎任何绝境中夺回胜利。

en: The world is hidden to him, but its secrets are not.
zh: 世界对他隐匿，其秘密却不然。

en: You are who you choose to be.
zh: 你为 谁你 选择以 是.

en: It consumes everything it can entangle, no matter what, or who, that might be.
zh: 它吞噬一切能缠住的事物——不论是什么，或是谁。

en: Vigil damaged by passage of fallen one. repairs approved.
zh: 祈夜因落者之过而受损。已批准修复。

en: "I looked, and behold, an ashen horse; and  he who sat on it had the name Death."
zh: 「我观看，见有一匹灰色马；骑在马上的，名字叫作死。」

en: Born in the light, he serves it in darkness.
zh: 生于光明，却在黑暗中侍奉它。

en: "What do you mean the princess is in another Temple?"
zh: 「公主在另一座神殿是什么意思？」

en: "If you seek to understand immortality, you must first discern the nature of death," the druid cautioned.
zh: 「若你想理解不朽，须先辨明死亡的本质，」德鲁伊告诫道。

en: The dreams of Sadranis and his summoners would be indistinguishable from nightmares for most people.
zh: 对多数人而言，萨德拉尼斯与其召唤者的梦，与噩梦并无分别。

en: "As haunted a relic as I've encountered, but now, no more haunted than we." -- Alastor Nellin
zh: 「我所遇过最受萦绕的遗物；而如今，它并不比我们更受萦绕。」——阿拉斯托·内林

en: For centuries, Zahral's forests have kept the secrets of the ancients.
zh: 数世纪以来，扎拉尔的森林守护着远古的秘密。

en: For some, the dreams brought new possibilities, for others, new terrors to share with the world.
zh: 对有些人，梦境带来新的可能；对另一些人，则是可与世界分享的新恐惧。

en: Even a tiny spider can kill you if you don't see it coming.
zh: 哪怕是只小蜘蛛，只要你看不见，也能要你的命。
绝对的腐化带来绝对的力量。

en: Let the stars guide your path when all other light abandons you.
zh: 当一切光芒弃你而去，让星辰指引你的路。

en: Just as the stars guide travellers, Cetra guides the stars.
zh: 正如星辰指引旅人，塞特拉指引星辰。

en: "Do not despair, child. You have the resolve and strength to meet your fate. You need only accept it."
zh: 「不要绝望，孩子。你有决心与力量去面对命运。你只需接纳它。」

en: In the fell clutch of circumstance, I have not winced nor cried aloud. Under the bludgeonings of chance, my head is bloody, but unbowed.
zh: 在命运的铁爪中，我不曾退缩，也不曾哭喊。在机遇的重击下，我头破血流，却傲然不屈。

en: True heroes are guided by her starlight.
zh: 真正的英雄由她的星光指引。

en: Be careful who you follow into battle.
Shards more effective than previous power sources.
zh: 碎片比以往的动力源更有效。

en: Her bright demeanor spreads warmth throughout Alosya.
zh: 她明朗的神情把温暖传遍阿洛西亚。

en: Her bright demeanor spreads warmth throughout Alosya.
zh: 她明朗的神情把温暖传遍阿洛西亚。

en: Together, we thrive; alone, we perish.
Much more silent than their name would imply.
Once the Void has a hold on you, there is no escape.
zh: 一旦虚空抓住你，便无处可逃。
必须维持多面体核心温度

en: She dreamt of iron and glory.
Her poison erodes the mightiest armor.
zh: 她的毒素侵蚀最坚固的铠甲。

en: Always looking for new students to  educate on the true nature of pain.
zh: 总在寻找新的学生，好教他们痛苦的真正本质。
死亡严密守护它的秘密。

en: "Blood!  Shed their blood!  The Fallen One has come to carry us to glory! To remake our world!"
zh: 「血！让他们流血！落者已来，带我们奔向荣耀！重塑我们的世界！」

en: You fools will learn the truth of your 'gifts' soon enough!
zh: 你们这些蠢货很快就会明白所谓「赐福」的真相！

en: "The Gatekeeper is no more! The souls of the damned shall transform this cursed land into a new netherworld!"
zh: 「守门人已不复存在！该死者的灵魂将把这片诅咒之地变成新的冥界！」

en: Their chants twisted in on themselves until there was nothing left but madness.
zh: 他们的吟诵自行扭曲，直到只剩疯狂。

en: Others fear the dark, he thrives in it.
zh: 别人惧怕黑暗，他在其中茁壮。

en: Those with the gift of foresight often need help discerning the difference between what is and what will be.
zh: 拥有预知之才的人，往往需要帮助分辨「现在」与「将至」。

en: Just hope she never has eyes for you.
zh: 但愿她的目光永远不会落在你身上。

en: The druids nourish life, but do not think for a moment that it is because they fear death.
zh: 德鲁伊滋养生命，但切莫以为那是因为他们惧怕死亡。

en: Not all who seek death find it. Some find a worse fate.
zh: 并非所有寻死者都找得到死亡。有些人找到了更糟的命运。

en: Sometimes the most dangerous thing is a wide smile.
zh: 有时最危险的，是那一抹灿烂的笑。

en: OBJECT RETRieveD.  UNKNOWNLIFE FORMs Detected. REquestinstructions.
zh: 物体已回收。侦测到未知生命体。请求指示。

en: The distrust they sow is what makes them dangerous.
zh: 他们播下的不信任，正是其危险所在。

en: Good. Bad. I'm the one with the sword.
zh: 好的。坏的。试试带剑的那个。

en: The job is tough, but the smell is worse.
I just wanted to pet one!
"How many demons have you slain, stranger?" Sar asked, lowering his massive sword.  "One so far," Nellin replied, and grinned.  "But it was a really, really big one."
zh: 「陌生人，你杀过多少恶魔？」萨尔放低巨剑问道。「到目前为止一个，」内林答道，咧嘴一笑，「不过那一个可真是……特别大。」

en: Having accepted death, they have nothing left to fear.
zh: 既已接纳死亡，他们便无所畏惧。

en: They see knowledge where there is madness.
zh: 他们在疯狂中看见知识。

en: The screams and wails weave a tortured hymn.
zh: 尖叫与哀号织成受折磨的圣歌。

en: "He will come in one of the pre-chosen forms."
zh: 「他将以预定的诸形之一到来。」

en: "Empty your mind, be formless, shapeless -- like water."
Tell me what you see, not what you think you see.
zh: 告诉我你看见了什么，而不是你以为看见了什么。

en: The greaT seal has fallen. exploration project approVeD.
zh: 大封印已坠。探索计划获准。

en: The great seal has fallen. Exploration project approved.
zh: 大封印已坠。探索计划获准。

en: Their currency is flesh and bone.
zh: 他们的货币是血肉与白骨。

en: Don't tell him your fears, that spoils the fun.
zh: 别告诉他你的恐惧，那会扫兴。

en: A soul a day keeps the Dreadmare away.

The Arha teach us that in time all traditions
break under the weight of principle.
zh: 亚哈教导我们：假以时日，一切传统都会在原则的重压下崩裂。

en: The dream was painful, but the reality was torture.
zh: 梦很痛苦，现实却是酷刑。

en: At the edge of the world, she is a guide to everything beyond.
zh: 在世界边缘，她是通往彼岸一切的向导。

en: Some people ruin all the fun.
In the Dreamscape, the line between impossible and possible is as illusory as everything else.
zh: 在梦境中，不可能与可能之间的界限，与其他一切同样虚幻。

en: Are you sure you want to know?
Expand what you understand to be possible until it includes that which you believed to be impossible.
zh: 扩展你对「可能」的理解，直到它包含你曾以为不可能之事。

en: Look upon what might have been and what may come to pass.
zh: 凝视本可能发生之事，以及或许将至之事。

en:
A gold giant: taller than the mountains
and silent as the sun.
zh: 金色巨人，高过群山，静如大海。

en: The manifestation of a forest's vengeful dreams.
The Dreamwillow's lullaby echoes throughout Ogo.
zh: 梦柳的摇篮曲回荡整个奥戈。

en: Their rituals are a beautiful combination of dance, lullaby, and sleep.
zh: 他们的仪式是舞蹈、摇篮曲与睡眠的美丽结合。

en: Depth: Unknown. Sensors indicate unknown energy source ahead.
zh: 深度：未知。传感器显示前方有未知能源。

en:
The spacing of the stones is geometry.
The space itself is magic.
zh:
石阵的间距是几何。
那空间本身是魔法。

en: During their initiation, druids receive a lifeless wreath. When it is reborn, so are they.
zh: 入会时，德鲁伊会得到一圈无生之花环。当它重生，他们亦然。

en: "Permanence is merely an illusion brought about by equally impermanent lives," Dhartha expounded.
zh: 「永恒不过是同样无常的生命所造成的幻象，」达萨阐说道。

en: His healing chants replenish life in the wake of chaos.
zh: 他的疗愈吟诵在混沌过后补回生命。

en:
In the caverns below, you will find limitless power
surrounded by fire and death.
zh:
在下方的洞窟里，你将找到无尽的力量
被火焰与死亡环绕。

en: In his scrying pool, the secrets of wars past, present, and future are all laid bare.
zh: 在他的占卜池中，过往、当下与未来之战的秘密尽皆袒露。

en: Ezem read briefly, and then ruefully dropped the scroll."It astounds me," he muttered, "what passes for an idea in this land."
zh: 埃泽姆匆匆读过，苦笑着丢下卷轴。「真令人吃惊，」他咕哝道，「这片土地上什么都能算作想法。」

en: Ezem read briefly, and then ruefully dropped the scroll."It astounds me," he muttered, "what passes for an idea in this land."
zh: 埃泽姆匆匆读过，苦笑着丢下卷轴。「真令人吃惊，」他咕哝道，「这片土地上什么都能算作想法。」

en: She soars over New Vigil to close each night, blessing all below with a new day's light.
zh: 她掠过新祈夜，为每个夜晚收束，以新一日的光祝福下方众生。

en: "Did anyone see that? I put a hole in that mountain!" - Emma Ironheart
zh: 「有人看见了吗？我在那座山上打了个洞！」——艾玛·铁心

en:
"Why in the five hells would I be calling you if
I didn't need help?" - Emma Ironheart
zh: 「要不是我需要帮忙，我干嘛打给你？」——艾玛·铁心

en:
"This proves it. Emma,
you're a genius." - Emma Ironheart
zh: 「这就证明了。艾玛，你是个天才。」——艾玛·铁心

en:
"This place is falling apart.
It's perfect." - Emma Ironheart
zh: 「这地方快散架了。完美。」——艾玛·铁心

en: Emri paused above the noble as her blade hovered. "When you have conquered everything, Xeron" she said, "there is still Nothing to fear."
zh: 艾姆瑞停在贵族上方，刃尖悬停。「当你征服了一切，泽伦，」她说，「仍有虚无值得畏惧。」

en: Without the real world to to constrain her, Emri became even more gruesomely efficient.
zh: 没有现实世界的束缚，艾姆瑞变得更加残酷高效。

en: Sharp, but fleeting, her sting kills before pain sets in.
zh: 锋利却短暂——她的蛰刺在痛感到来前便已致命。

en: He tears down everyone and everything that gets in Emri's way.
zh: 凡挡在艾姆瑞路上的人与物，他都会拆毁。

en: One man's trash is another monk's treasure.
zh: 一人的垃圾，是另一僧侣的宝藏。

en: By the time you know it's there, it's already too late.
zh: 等你察觉它在那儿，已经太迟了。

en: Surrendering herself to fate, she found peace.
zh: 将自己交托命运，她找到了安宁。

en: Surrendering herself to machines, she found new possibilities.
zh: 将自己交托机械，她找到了新的可能。

en: Surrendering himself to the question, he found the answer.
zh: 将自己交托疑问，他找到了答案。

en: Surrendering himself to the end, he found the means.
zh: 将自己交托终局，他找到了手段。

en: Vigil has fought bravely in the dim light. Only the Askaras know whether it is dawn or dusk .
zh: 祈夜在昏光中英勇奋战。唯有阿斯卡拉知晓那是黎明还是黄昏。

en: The voidspawn that aren't banished or destroyed are made to wish they had been.
zh: 那些未被放逐或摧毁的虚空孽种，会被折磨到但愿自己早已被放逐或摧毁。

en: Even death is no escape for her prey.
zh: 连死亡也不是她猎物的逃脱之路。

en: The first Everbloom seedlings were gifted to heroes of the Second War, who planted them near the capital to encourage the healing of the land.
zh: 第一批永绽幼苗赠予第二次大战的英雄，他们将其栽于都城附近，以催促大地愈合。

en: The first Everbloom seedlings were gifted to heroes of the Second War, who planted them near the capital to encourage the healing of the land.
zh: 第一批永绽幼苗赠予第二次大战的英雄，他们将其栽于都城附近，以催促大地愈合。

en: "Because exhaust vent maintenance wasn't already dangerous enough."
zh: 「就因为排风口维护还不够危险。」

en: At the foot of Parhama, the remnant of a great statue lies. From its unblinking eye, a call to action is each day read aloud.
zh: 在帕哈马山脚，躺着一座巨像的残骸。每日，人们从它永不闭合的眼中朗诵行动的召唤。

en:
He was found dead in the forest:
a million little cuts.
zh: 人们在森林里发现他时，他已死于无数细小的伤口。

en: "I stood at the mountiantop, held out the Eye, and finally saw the world."
zh: 「我立于山巅，举起慧眼，终于看见了这个世界。」

en: The pathfinder raised a hand, "Quiet. We must be respectful lest we draw the swamp's ire."
zh: 寻路者举手示意：「安静。我们必须保持敬意，免得招来沼泽的怒火。」

en: "Walking with a friend in the dark is better than walking alone in the light."
zh: 「与友人同行于暗处，胜过独自行走于光明。」

en: The Lifebound call them 'leylines', the Mechana just call them fuel.
zh: 命约称之为「灵脉」，机械则称之为燃料。

en: "Beware the words you long to hear, lest they lead you to the end you fear."
zh: 「当心你渴望听见的话语，免得它们引你走向你所惧怕的结局。」

en: She smiled as she darted quickly through the thicket, toying with the flytraps as they snapped shut behind her.
zh: 她笑着飞掠灌丛，逗弄身后啪地合拢的捕蝇草。

en: It's not the teeth you should be worried about.
zh: 该担心的不是那些牙齿。

en: The swamp is as perilous as it is hungry.
The suit keeps them safe in even the fiercest forges.
zh: 即便在最猛烈的熔炉中，这套装具也能护他们周全。

en: Her billows feed the fires of creation for all of Hedron.
zh: 她的风箱为整个赫德隆的创造之火添薪。

en: Even on Arha, wisdom can be lost as ages pass and libraries are filled with new writings.
zh: 即便在亚哈，智慧也会随岁月流逝而散佚，书库被新的著述填满。

en: Even a tiny nuisance is able to bring down giant fortifications if left unchecked.
zh: 哪怕是小小的滋扰，若不加制止，也能摧毁巨大的工事。

en: You'll have a ruff time getting by his watchful eyes.
zh: 想从他警觉的目光下溜走，可不容易。

en: "Dreams and plants need only be nurtured to grow."
zh: 「梦与植物，只需滋养便能生长。」

en:
The only difference between
genius and madness is execution.
zh: 天才与疯狂的唯一差别，在于执行。

en: The spirits consider the crystals equal parts portent and plaything.
zh: 精魂视晶体为征兆，亦为玩物。
它们有种魔法般的美味。

en: Both druids and mechanics can appreciate redundancy.
zh: 德鲁伊与技工都能欣赏冗余。

en: Gnome improvement is serious business in Hedron.
zh: 在赫德隆，侏儒改良是正经事。

en: Dozens LOST each Week WHILEensURING a FRICTIONless WORLD
zh: 每周都有数十人为确保无摩擦的世界而失踪

en: An unheeded raven begets a thousand crows.
zh: 被忽视的渡鸦，会招来千只乌鸦。

en: The more the Askara learned of darkness from Sadranis, the further they ventured in search of those to help.
zh: 阿斯卡拉从萨德拉尼斯学到越多关于黑暗的事，就越深入去寻找需要帮助的人。

en: It's what isn't there that frightens; it's what is there that kills.
zh: 令人恐惧的是不在场之物；杀人的是在场之物。

en: They are nimble with the quill -- fast enough to keep pace with history as it unfolds.
zh: 他们笔锋迅捷——快到足以跟上正在展开的历史。

en: Time to kick things into high gear.
zh: 该把事情推到高速挡了。

en: attention godslayer: conventional war againsT Fallen ONe a waste of time and resources.  New plan:  destroy  with dimensional cannon as shown
zh: 注意，弑神者：对落者发动常规战争是浪费时间与资源。新计划：用如图所示的维度加农摧毁之

en: "Now I am become Death, destroyer of worlds."
zh: 「如今我成了死亡，诸世界的毁灭者。」
侦测到碎片。挖掘进行中。

en: situation: great seal breached. scattered devices from across all realms are reconnecting. miracle or Tragedy?  please advise.
zh: 状况：大封印破损。散落各界的装置正在重新连结。奇迹，还是悲剧？请指示。

en: To the Mechana, magic is just another form of energy.
zh: 对机械而言，魔法不过是另一种能量。

en: Like his creations, the life of a Hedron Pyromaniac often ends with a bang.
zh: 如同他的造物，赫德隆纵火狂的一生往往以一声巨响收场。

en: none of them along the line know what any of it is worth
zh: 沿线的人谁也不知道这一切究竟值什么

en: "Gather your forces - tonight, we come to the aid of Ogo."
zh: 「集结你们的部队——今夜，我们驰援奥戈。」

en:
"Do you smell that?"
"Yes... There's more than prey to be hunted tonight."
zh:
「你闻到了吗？」
「是的……今夜要猎的不只是猎物。」

en: You'd be just as crabby if you couldn't  find a shell big enough.
zh: 要是你也找不到够大的壳，脾气一样会臭。

en: Hurricanes borrow their name from the beast, an ancient demigod that wanders the seas.
zh: 飓风借用了那头古半神的名字——它游荡于海上。

en: A vast upgrade over the ID-0NT model.
zh: 相对 ID-0NT 型号的大幅升级。

en: You may escape the Temples, but you'll never escape Iku.
zh: 你或许逃得过神殿，却永远逃不过伊库。

en: Operators spend months studying for their license to ill.
zh: 操作员要花数月学习，才拿得到「照亮」执照。

en: The Dreamscape doesn't create the possibilities, it simply shows them to us.
zh: 梦境并不创造可能，它只是把可能展示给我们。

en: The gauntlets outlive many recruits before finally finding a less temporary owner.
zh: 这副护手比许多新兵更长寿，直到终于等到不那么短暂的主人。

en: They see possibility where there is difficulty.
zh: 他们在艰难中看见可能。

en: The Ferromancers gave it the spark of curiosity it  needed to constantly dig deeper.
zh: 铁术士给了它不断向下深挖所需的好奇火花。

en: His blade and will are sharp, forged anew in the light.
zh: 他的刃与意志皆锋利，在光明中重铸。

en:
Fear has a face.
Allow me to show it to you.
zh:
恐惧有一张脸。
让我指给你看。

en: Metal teaches us that we must endure.
zh: 金属教导我们：必须忍耐。

en: "This is the fight I have spent my entire life training for."
zh: 「这正是我毕生训练所为的一战。」

en: The Journeymen reject the monastic life on Arha in favor of finding and sharing knowledge among the other realms.
zh: 行者拒绝亚哈的修道生活，转而在其他界域寻找并分享知识。

en: "A fool thinks himself to be wise, but a wise man knows himself to be a fool."
zh: 「愚者自以为智，智者自知为愚。」

en: This is why we can't have nice things.
zh: 这就是为什么我们留不住好东西。

en: The Dreamscape gate is corrupt, a hellish wound on two worlds.
zh: 梦境之门已腐化，是横跨两界的炼狱伤口。

en: They see those that wish to remain hidden.
zh: 他们能看见那些想保持隐匿的人。

en: Her domain offers tranquility when everyplace else is embroiled in turmoil.
zh: 别处皆陷动荡时，她的领地仍提供宁静。

en: Her domain offers tranquility when everyplace else is embroiled in turmoil.
zh: 别处皆陷动荡时，她的领地仍提供宁静。

en: Where you see nature, I see raw materials.
zh: 你看见自然，我看见原材料。

en: Warning:  junkyard may be hazardous.  Proceed with caution
zh: 警告：废料场可能危险。请谨慎前进

en:
The mountian, its metals, these ruins,
they are all his weapons.
zh:
那座山、它的金属、这些废墟，
都是他的武器。

en: "We do not give the metal life, we only help it find its form."
zh: 「我们并非赋予金属生命，只是助它寻得形态。」

en: A giant whose words make flowers bloom and forests grow.
zh: 巨人的言语使繁花绽放、森林生长。

en:
The universe is a vast wonder, and the miracle of
existence is a precious gift. That is why being a hero
means defending life.
zh:
宇宙是浩瀚的奇迹，而存在本身
是珍贵的礼物。因此，成为英雄
意味着捍卫生命。

en:
Speed may impress, but timing is the key to
victory. It’s not how fast you act, but when you
strike that determines the outcome.
zh:
速度或许令人惊叹，但时机才是
胜利的关键钥。决定结果的不是你有多快，
而是你何时出手。

en:
Every invention is a cog in a larger machine, each
built upon the last, from the first spark of
mortal-made fire to the tools of the Mechana people.
zh:
每项发明都是更大机器中的齿轮，
层层相依，从凡人第一簇人造之火
到机械族的工具。

en:
Choose what endures over what tempts. This is
the path to mastering the enlightened arts.
zh:
选择能持久之物，而非诱惑之物。
此乃精通圣贤之道的路径。

en:
To live in balance with the world around us is
to find our place in the greater tapestry of
life.
zh:
与周遭世界和谐共处，
便是在生命的宏大织锦中
找到自己的位置。

en:
Embrace the void, for it is in this absence
that we carve our own meaning.
zh:
拥抱虚空，因为正是在这缺席之中，
我们刻下自己的意义。

en:
It is the mechanics of purpose and experience that
define us, shaping not just who we are, but what we
can become.
zh:
定义我们的是目的与经验的机理，
塑造的不只是我们是谁，还有我们
能成为什么。

en:
They whisper of stars—dead, long forgotten,
and yet to be—the inheritor of all the light
lost to time.
zh:
他们低语星辰——已死的、久被遗忘的、
以及尚未到来的——时间遗失之光的
继承者。

en: In the Mushroom Dæl, with tobacco and honey on the breeze, may be found the half-shoe man.
zh: 在蘑菇谷，烟草与蜂蜜随风而来，或可遇见半鞋之人。

en: There is but one true Mother, and all the Lifebound are her children.
zh: 唯有一位真正的母亲，所有命约皆是她的孩子。

en: His spirit, manifest through the Dreamscape.
No matter how far he may wander, he can always find the way back to his mushroom.
zh: 无论他游荡多远，总能找回通往蘑菇的路。

en: The bog swirled and bubbled with her incantations, awakening to the dark new purpose she had in mind.
zh: 沼泽随她的咒文翻涌冒泡，苏醒于她心中阴暗的新目的。

en: "He takes the form of a dragon in the Dream world, but his real power lies in this one," explained Dhartha.
zh: 「他在梦界取龙形，但其真正力量在此界，」达萨解释道。

en: The moon's magic took over, pushing everything  out until instinct was all that was left.
zh: 月之魔力接管一切，把别的都挤出去，直到只剩本能。

en: They live for the forest, but they can also die for it.
zh: 他们为林而生，也能为林而死。

en: She brings rest to those who know it least.
zh: 她把安息带给最少得到安息的人。

en: Unlike other regions of Vigil, Ogo is safer at night than during the day.
zh: 与祈夜其他地区不同，奥戈夜里比白天更安全。

en: "To glimpse a stag is a great blessing -- but do not presume to hunt one. That is for gods alone." -Kam, Pathwarden
zh: 「瞥见雄鹿是大福——但切勿妄图猎杀。那是诸神之事。」——寻径守卫卡姆

en: Once it has you in its grasp, there is no escape.
zh: 一旦被它抓住，便无处可逃。

en: "I will permit it to pass over me and through me. And when it has gone past I will turn the inner eye to see its path."
zh: 「我将容它从我身上越过、穿过。当它过去，我将以内眼看见它的路径。」

en: "To see that which you seek, you must first close your eyes." -Scroll Inscription
zh: 「欲见所寻，须先闭目。」——卷轴铭文

en: Even in an unnatural night, Cetra guides us.
zh: 即便在不自然的夜里，塞特拉仍指引我们。

en: There is more than one path to the top of the mountain.
zh: 通往山顶的路不止一条。

en: At the height of the war, the Godslayer ascended six-thousand, six-hundred sixty-six steps to seek Dhartha's counsel, only to be turned away.
zh: 战争正酣时，弑神者登上六千六百六十六级台阶求见达萨，却被拒之门外。

en:
The Mechana let nothing go to waste:
recycle the soldiers, train them again.
zh:
机械从不浪费：
回收士兵，再度训练。

en:
"I wonder what kind of dent this thing is
going to make." - Emma Ironheart
zh: 「真好奇这玩意儿能砸出多大坑。」——艾玛·铁心

en: Deliverers of Lies, sowers of confusion.
zh: 谎言的传递者，混乱的播种者。

en: Only Dhartha fully understood the role the boy would come to play in the realms' distant future.
zh: 唯有达萨完全明白这男孩将在诸界遥远未来扮演的角色。

en: The Order sensed a disturbance, but could not decipher its source.
zh: 教团察觉到扰动，却无法辨明其源头。

en: In the full moon's light, nature's beauty can be a terror to behold .
zh: 在满月光辉下，自然之美亦可令人心惊。

en: Ogo's leylines can be seen at night by the faint glow of the Moonveil drawn to the magic.
zh: 夜间可见奥戈的灵脉——月纱被魔力牵引，发出微光。

en: The horn's note always signals a harvest.
Wield the devil, and hell will tremble before you.
zh: 执魔刃，地狱亦将在你面前战栗。

en: The last of her swords and bearing her name.
zh: 她最后的剑，并冠以其名。

en: "Death and decay are not just the end of an old life,  they are the beginning of a new one."
zh: 「死亡与腐朽不只是旧生命的终结，也是新生命的开始。」

en: For centuries, the Temples have warped every aspect of the valley surrounding them.
zh: 数世纪以来，神殿扭曲了环绕它们的山谷的一切。

en: If while walking you should find a lock of hair, tie one end around a finger and follow it deeper into the wood. It will lead you either to the queen, or to your doom -- whichever you deserve.
zh: 若你行路时捡到一缕发丝，将其一端系于指上，循之深入林中。它会引你至女王，或至你的末日——端看你配得哪一个。

en: She sees all. She loves all. She is all.
zh: 她看见一切。她爱一切。她即是一切。

en: With their abilities augmented by Hedron technology, Sadranis' followers were able to venture even further into the darkness.
zh: 靠赫德隆科技强化能力后，萨德拉尼斯的追随者得以更深地潜入黑暗。

en: "It would be a shame to let all this terror go to waste."
zh: 「让这些恐惧白白浪费就太可惜了。」

en: Rattling bones and screams of death announce his approach more effectively than a roar ever could.
zh: 骨碌作响与死亡的尖叫宣告他的到来，比咆哮更有效。

en:
Bomb for you... bomb for you...
and bomb for you.
Sadranis formed his own clan of demon slayers, a sorcerous parallel to the Black Watch.
zh: 萨德拉尼斯组建了自己的屠魔氏族——黑卫的魔法对照。

en: Sadranis formed his own clan of demon slayers, a sorcerous parallel to the Black Watch.
zh: 萨德拉尼斯组建了自己的屠魔氏族——黑卫的魔法对照。

en: Need something that breaks bones and spirits?
zh: 需要一样能砸碎骨头与灵魂的东西吗？

en: The Templar's thoughts turned on themselves, and he knew it was already too late.
zh: 圣殿武士的思绪自行翻搅，他明白已经太迟了。

en: The leading cause of death on Hedron?  Curiosity.
zh: 赫德隆的头号死因？好奇心。

en: For her, the dream and the real are one in the same.
zh: 对她而言，梦与真实本是一体。

en: The beginning can be just as violent as the end.
zh: 开端可以与终局一样暴烈。

en: Every Void ritualist could sense the power of the shards, but only a select few could wield it.
zh: 每个虚空仪式师都能感知碎片之力，但只有少数能驾驭它。

en: They know the threat that is coming... and welcome it.
zh: 他们知道威胁将至……并欢迎它。

en: The result of conscious death in an unconscious world.
zh: 清醒之死落在无意识世界的结果。

en: Love is a dream. Love is a nightmare.
zh: 爱是一场梦。爱是一场梦魇。

en: "Make haste. If our new world is to be preserved, we must warn the others of Xeron's plans," Nairi urged.
zh: 「赶快。若要保全我们的新世界，就必须警告他人泽伦的计划，」奈瑞催促道。

en: Keeps the place free of the little ones, at least.
zh: 至少能让这里少些小东西。

en: He watches for heroic deeds, weaving their tales of glory into the fabric of the cosmos.
zh: 他守望英勇事迹，将其荣耀传说织入宇宙的经纬。

en: Look into the Orb and you might just find your soul staring back.
zh: 凝视宝珠，或许会看见你的灵魂回望。

en: "We once considered them pets- now, we consider them partners."
zh: 「我们曾视它们为宠物——如今，视它们为伙伴。」

en: His will and blade are one.
"He's not playing with his food, he's teaching it a lesson."
zh: 「他不是在玩弄食物，是在给它上一课。」

en:
"Child, this new world must have north and south, east and west," Logos said. Oziah drew his sword and cut twice.
"Father, it is done," he replied.
zh:
「孩子，这新世界须有南北东西，」逻各斯说。奥齐亚拔剑连斩两下。
「父亲，完成了，」他答道。

en: Even the immortals fear his mighty blade
zh: 连不朽者也惧他那柄神兵

en:
"Child, this new world must have north and south, east and west," Logos said. Oziah drew his sword and cut twice.
"Father, it is done," he replied.
zh:
「孩子，这新世界须有南北东西，」逻各斯说。奥齐亚拔剑连斩两下。
「父亲，完成了，」他答道。

en: Pasythea grants her protection only to those who have proven themselves brave enough to warrant it.
zh: 帕西忒亚只把庇护赐给已证明自己配得勇敢之人。

en: There is no place you can venture that the pathfinders have not already called home.
zh: 没有你能踏足、而寻路者尚未称之为家的地方。

en: Heroes dwell beyond the final turn in the road.
zh: 英雄居于道路最后一道弯之外。

en: He's willing to wait for it.
"Kythis has fled, and the souls of the damned howl against Deofol's untended gate." -- Sadranis
zh: 「凯西斯已逃，该死者的灵魂对着无人照管的迪奥弗之门嚎叫。」——萨德拉尼斯

en: "Kythis has fled, and the souls of the damned howl against Deofol's untended gate." -- Sadranis
zh: 「凯西斯已逃，该死者的灵魂对着无人照管的迪奥弗之门嚎叫。」——萨德拉尼斯

en: "The eye will guide you where your own cannot."
zh: 「慧眼会指引你去往自己的眼睛到不了的地方。」

en: "The eye will guide you where your own cannot."
zh: 「慧眼会指引你去往自己的眼睛到不了的地方。」

en: "The ultimate measure of a person is not where they stand in moments of comfort, but where they stand at times of challenge."
zh: 「衡量一个人的终极标准，不是他们在安逸时站在何处，而是在挑战时站在何处。」

en: It could lead anywhere, and that's usually the problem.
zh: 它可能通向任何地方——而这通常就是问题所在。

en: You're going to feel a little funny at first...
zh: 一开始你会觉得有点不对劲……

en: P.R.I.M.E. stands ready at the heart of Hedron, always vigilant against whatever threats emerge.
zh: P.R.I.M.E. 驻守赫德隆之心，时刻警惕任何出现的威胁。

en: The tinkerers could no longer distinguish their own thoughts from those of the machine.
zh: 工匠们已分不清自己的思绪与机器的思绪。

en: The tinkerers could no longer distinguish their own thoughts from those of the machine.
zh: 工匠们已分不清自己的思绪与机器的思绪。

en: An initiate of the Templar Order, he is given a practice blade no less unwieldy than his youthful mind.
zh: 圣殿武士团的初学者，获赐的练习刃与其稚嫩心智一样难用。

en: Does anyone have a whole lot of salt?
Does anyone have a whole lot of salt?

As the armor is shaped by our thoughts,
the sword is directed by our will.
zh: 铠甲由我们的思绪塑形，利剑由我们的意志指引。

en: The wraith pushes and prods the weak-willed into  accepting cowardly paths as their only option.
zh: 幽魂推搡意志薄弱者，迫使他们把怯懦之路当作唯一选择。

en: You would never know how long the Qadim have stood guard by the ferocity with which they still defend the forest.
zh: 看他们仍以何种凶猛守卫森林，你绝不会知道卡迪姆已驻守多久。

en: They see light where there is darkness.
zh: 他们在黑暗中看见光明。

en: Nairi corrected them, "He's no hermit. He simply considers wildlife and his dreams to be more tolerable than people."
zh: 奈瑞纠正他们：「他不是隐士。他只是觉得野生动物与梦，比人更能忍受。」

en:
All things can corrupt when
minds are prone to evil.
zh: 爱是一场梦。爱是一场梦魇。

en: core power output up 20%.Monk Mortality rate up 20%.
zh: 堆芯功率输出提升 20%。僧侣死亡率提升 20%。

en: Sometimes, the curious become the mad.
Alternate fuel source has unlocked additonal capacities.
zh: 替代燃料源已解锁额外能力。

en: What it lacks in finesse it makes up for in results.
zh: 它缺的是精细，补的是结果。

en: Not all Pathwardens are able to embrace their instincts without giving in to them.
zh: 并非所有寻径守卫都能拥抱本能而不被本能吞没。

en: We can build it. We have the technology.
zh: 我们造得出来。我们有技术。
维修完毕。机组可投入运作。

en: "You need a keystone? I can get you a keystone."
zh: 「你要钥石？我能给你搞到钥石。」

en: Her gentle melodies drift through the dream meadows, filling the souls throughout with peace and possibility.
zh: 她温柔的旋律漂过梦原，把安宁与可能填入各方灵魂。

en: The quickest path is not always the one you can see.
zh: 最快的路并不总是你能看见的那条。

en: "What if something comes out of the portal?" asked the initiate. Sadranis snickered, "It will be terrified of what awaits it."
zh: 「要是有东西从传送门出来怎么办？」初学者问。萨德拉尼斯嗤笑：「它会对等待它的东西感到恐惧。」

en: An extension of the dark souls who wield it.
zh: 挥舞者黑暗灵魂的延伸。

en: The watchtowers jut out of the darkness, as if to keep watch on the light.
zh: 瞭望塔刺出黑暗，仿佛在监视光明。

en:
Something is hunting the bears,
but we know not what.
The monk listened to the trees' whispered mantra, and the entire world fell silent around him.
zh: 僧侣聆听树木低语的咒语，周遭整个世界都安静下来。

en: The noble Honiskrot were ill at ease in the presence of the mysterious shards.
zh: 高贵的霍尼斯克洛特在神秘碎片面前惴惴不安。

en: Write with blood, and you will see that blood is spirit.
zh: 以血书写，你将看见血即是灵。

en: "Senses. Speed. Reflexes. Cunning. Only a fool would call this a curse."
zh: 「感官。速度。反射。狡黠。只有傻瓜才会称之为诅咒。」

en: The very embodiment of everything that can go wrong in Hedron.
zh: 赫德隆一切可能出错之事的化身。

en: Sometimes it's best to let sleeping bears lie.
zh: 有时最好别吵醒沉睡的熊。

en: "Indulge your imagination in every possible flight."
zh: 「放任你的想象作每一次可能的翱翔。」

en: The shifting planes served up a never-ending supply of victims for the cruel Estryne clan.
zh: 变幻的位面为残忍的埃斯特林氏族提供源源不断的牺牲者。

en: Dhartha assured them, "Not all who look into the darkness look to serve it. Just as we wield light, he wields darkness."
zh: 达萨安抚他们：「并非所有凝视黑暗者都侍奉黑暗。正如我们挥舞光明，他挥舞黑暗。」

en: The best creations can come from the place we least expect.
zh: 最好的创造，可能来自我们最不意料的地方。

en: I am Eternal. What hope have you to defeat me?
zh: 我是永恒。你们有何指望击败我？

en: He always knows the price of your soul.
zh: 他总知道你灵魂的价码。

en: They'll build out of anything, even you.
zh: 它们用任何东西建造，包括你。

en: Cetra guides her children not to their destiny, but to the path that will lead them there.
zh: 塞特拉指引她的孩子，不是直接到命运，而是到通往命运的路。

en: When the last shred of remorse had been purged, they were ready to join the Black Watch.
zh: 当最后一丝悔恨被涤尽，他们便准备好加入黑卫。

en: When they view the machine as part of themselves, they are ready for their work to begin.
zh: 当他们视机器为自身一部分时，便准备开始工作。

en: With a single stroke, the tyrant was slain and his training was complete.
zh: 一击之下，暴君伏诛，他的训练亦告完成。

en: One man's trash is another bot's weapon.
zh: 此人之垃圾，乃彼机之兵器。

en: The scraping hum of the metal guides them as they give purpose to discarded parts.
zh: 金属的刮擦嗡鸣引导他们，赋予废弃零件以目的。

en: The monks gathered around the All-Seeing Eye, aghast at the the future it foretold.
zh: 僧侣们围着全知之眼，对其预示的未来惊骇不已。

en: Her flame sears a path right into the heart of darkness.
zh: 她的火焰灼出一条直抵黑暗之心的路。

en: Its many fins rise up like the sails of a vast armada.
zh: 它众多鳍片升起，如同一支庞大舰队的帆。

en: Responsible for some of Hedron's greatest technological advances,,, and even greater explosions
zh: 负责赫德隆一些最伟大的科技进步……以及更伟大的爆炸

en: "The world is new, but our past is still with us."
zh: 「世界是新的，但我们的过去仍与我们同在。」

en: "The left path holds death for you, Godslayer. The right path, death for her. You must choose quickly- Samael is on the move."
zh: 「左路是你的死，弑神者。右路是她的死。你必须速决——萨麦尔已在行动。」

en: A choice is offered here, certainty is not.
zh: 此处提供选择，不提供确定。

en: A novice hears cacophony, a master hears only symphony.
zh: 新手听见嘈杂，大师只听见交响。

en: "Mother, beckon me home." - Ogo death rite
zh: 「母亲，召我归家。」——奥戈死亡仪式

en: The offspring of Samael and Nyx emerge fromthe Void regularily, and must be banished.
zh: 萨麦尔与尼克斯的子嗣常从虚空现身，必须被放逐。

en: Lethal fighters, made more deadly by their strange pets.
zh: 致命的战士，因奇特的宠物而更加致命。

en: Power never comes without a price.
When a lock is not enough, try a Shadowblade Sentry.
zh: 当锁不够用时，试试影刃哨兵。

en: Darkness teaches us to always beware.
zh: 黑暗教导我们时刻警惕。

en:
"Be careful, young hero," said the mystic.
"It does not take well to poor aim."
zh:
「小心，年轻的英雄，」秘术士说。
「它对糟糕的瞄准可不客气。」

en: "Just be careful when you throw it, Godslayer," the weaponmaster said with a frown.  "It will not suffer a wielder with poor aim."
zh: 「扔的时候小心点，弑神者，」兵器大师皱眉道。「它容不得瞄准差的持有者。」

en: As Braham stared at the compass, his entire body tingled. He knew where he had to go.
zh: 布拉汉盯着罗盘，全身发麻。他知道自己该去哪里。

en: "Many of my brethren cling to life, forgetting that it is only one half of nature's cycle."
zh: 「我许多同袍紧抓生命不放，却忘了它只是自然循环的一半。」

en: The smallest acts can do the most to keep hope alive, even in the darkest nights when it seems impossible.
zh: 即便在希望看似不可能的最黑暗之夜，最小的举动也能最有效地维系希望。

en: "Knowledge is just as important to the sprouts as water and sunlight."
zh: 「对幼苗而言，知识与水、阳光同样重要。」

en: The Temple of the Wind teaches its students to learn from both themselves and each other.
zh: 风之神殿教导学生向自己也向彼此学习。

en: There is no deadlier poison than pride.
zh: 没有比骄傲更致命的毒药。

en: forge the proper shape and complete the divine challenge
zh: 铸成正确的形状，完成神圣挑战

en: It didn't take long for the monks to harness the power of their cause.
zh: 僧侣们很快便驾驭了其使命之力。

en: As the Storm grew, one faction found itself uniquely suited to the task at hand.
zh: 风暴壮大时，有一个派系发现自己特别适合眼前的任务。

en: The price is simple - one spirit for another.
zh: 代价很简单——一个灵魂换另一个。

en: "Naturally, Emri's hunters were the ones to find the most morbid means of entry into the Temple of Life."
zh: 「自然地，是艾姆瑞的猎手找到了进入生命神殿最病态的入口。」

en: When chaos reigns, trust is the greatest strength, but it is an even greater weakness if exploited.
zh: 混沌当道时，信任是最强的力量；若被利用，也是更大的弱点。

en: Sowers lurk through the Five Realms, using whispers and rumors to erode the hope that keeps them intact.
zh: 播种者潜伏于五界，以耳语与谣言侵蚀维系它们的希望。

en: Not all of the bugs in Hedron's machinery are bad.
zh: 赫德隆机械里的虫子，并不都是坏的。

en: Though Dread Liza has departed the ObsidianRing, many of her deadly students remain.
zh: 尽管恐惧丽莎已离开黑曜环，她许多致命的门徒仍在。

en: If there is beauty in death, then the Spike Vixens are a sight to behold.
zh: 若死亡中有美，则刺狐女值得一睹。

en: If there is beauty in death, then the Spike Vixens are a sight to behold.
zh: 若死亡中有美，则刺狐女值得一睹。

en: If there is beauty in death, then the Spike Vixens are a sight to behold.
zh: 若死亡中有美，则刺狐女值得一睹。

en: Electricity is really just organized lightning.
zh: 电其实只是有组织的闪电。

en: Look to the past for help with the future.
zh: 向过去寻求对未来的帮助。

en: "Suffer now, and live the rest of your life as a champion."
zh: 「现在受苦，余生便以冠军之身而活。」

en: Emri's assassins always find their target,  regardless of where it believes it can hide.
zh: 艾姆瑞的刺客总能找到目标，不论它自以为能藏到哪里。

en: For every being, a star its own, a graceful watcher perched upon it, her voice familiar, her touch the same that cradled them in youth.
zh: 每个生灵都有属于自己的星，优雅的守望者栖于其上，声音熟悉，触碰一如幼时那份怀抱。

en: You might think that the Temple of Death would have the scarier inhabitants, but you'd be wrong.
zh: 你或许以为死亡神殿的住民更吓人——那你就错了。

en: Cries of "Charge!" followed by massive retreats can often be confusing for new recruits.
zh: 新兵常被「冲锋！」的喊声紧接大规模撤退搞糊涂。

en: Nature's cycle and starry sky hold no secrets for an ancient druid's eye.
zh: 自然循环与星空，对古老德鲁伊之眼毫无秘密。

en: The anvil's song echoes like low, rumbling thunder.
zh: 铁砧之歌如低沉雷鸣回响。

en: He moves so quickly he has no need for the cover of night.
zh: 他移动极快，无需夜色掩护。

en: An energizing force wherever she goes.
zh: 无论她去哪，都是一股充能之力。

en: "I do not wish to fight anymore, Master," Surya confided. Dhartha responded, "And that is why it must be you."
zh: 「师父，我不想再战斗了，」苏里亚坦白。达萨答道：「正因为如此，才必须是你。」

en: Prevents overload. increasesefficientcy. Not compatible with off-realm devices.
zh: 防止过载。提升效率。与界外装置不兼容。

en: Whispers of Adayu's powers emanated from the tablet while in the presence of the mysterious shards.
zh: 在神秘碎片近旁，关于阿达尤之力的低语自石板渗出。

en: Foremost of Logos' sons was Time: a cheater, a scoundrel, destined to lord over all in the end.
zh: 逻各斯诸子之首是时间：骗子、无赖，注定最终君临一切。

en: While the other factions dream of greatness, Hedron  is content to dream of great new inventions.
zh: 其他派系梦见伟大，赫德隆满足于梦见伟大的新发明。

en: The Sleeping Peaks hide more than just ore in their mountains.
zh: 沉眠诸峰隐藏的不只是山中矿石。

en: The Sleeping Peaks hide more than just ore in their mountains.
zh: 沉眠诸峰隐藏的不只是山中矿石。

en:
"It's like telepathy, but less effective."
- Emma Ironheart
zh:
像心灵感应，但没那么好用。
——艾玛·铁心

en: The Eye's protection extends as far as it can see.
zh: 慧眼的庇护延伸至其目力所及。

en: The Templar never use their swords. It is their keen intellect that makes the deeper cut.
zh: 圣殿武士从不动剑。令他们更深切入的是敏锐才智。

en: "Without knowledge, power is illusory. Without order, knowledge is fragmented. Without me, order is impossible."
zh: 「没有知识，力量便是幻象。没有秩序，知识便是碎片。没有我，秩序便不可能。」

en: "Without knowledge, power is illusory. Without order, knowledge is fragmented. Without me, order is impossible."
zh: 「没有知识，力量便是幻象。没有秩序，知识便是碎片。没有我，秩序便不可能。」

en: An impossible place to ponder the impossible.
zh: 一处思索不可能之事的不可能之地。

en: Their names are forgotten, but their deeds are not.
zh: 他们的名字被遗忘，事迹却不然。

en: The temple teaches common men and women to be brave when times call for swift, decisive action.
zh: 神殿教导凡人男女在需要迅疾果决之时勇敢起来。

en: everything that has happened before will happen again
zh: 曾经发生的一切都将再次发生

en: They're just bugs, soldier. How big could they be?
zh: 他们不过是虫子，士兵。能有多大？

en: Taking advantage of the chaos of Adayu's madness, demons punished Vigil for its past transgressions.
zh: 趁阿达尤疯狂的混乱，恶魔惩罚祈夜过往的罪愆。

en: Teyn's army arrives hungry for war and leaves full of meat.
zh: 泰恩的大军饥渴而来，饱食血肉而去。

en: It gives new meaning to being lost in thought.
zh: 给「沉浸于思绪」赋予了新含义。

en: The All-Seeing Eye pierces the veil of impossibility.
zh: 全知之眼洞穿不可能的帷幕。

en: divine schematic said to detail the primary function.  contains a place for all mechana.
zh: 据说详述主要功能的神圣图纸。为所有机械留有一席之地。

en: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
zh: 预测未来的最好方式是创造它。

en:
"I don't care how many tentacles you have.
I have an airship!" - Emma Ironheart
zh: 「我不管你有多少触手。我有飞艇！」——艾玛·铁心

en: Each branch, a separate path. Every seed, a new beginning.
zh: 每一枝条，一条分途。每一粒种子，一个新开端。

en: Not everything on New Vigil is terrifyingly weird, sometimes it's just run-of-the-mill scary.
zh: 新祈夜并非一切都诡异得吓人——有时只是普通地吓人。

en: Dangerous in the wild, disastrous in a city.
zh: 在野外危险，在城市则是灾难。

en: The local villagers have learned to be just  as wary of low tide as they are high tide.
zh: 当地村民已学会：退潮与涨潮同样要小心。

en: The local villagers have learned to be just as wary of low tides as they are high tides.
zh: 当地村民已学会：退潮与涨潮同样要小心。

en: She moved her hands through the water, altering the course of countless lives.
zh: 她的手拂过水面，改写无数生命的轨迹。

en: "The truth of the present lies in the shadows of our past"  - Emri
zh: 「当下的真相藏于我们过去的阴影」——艾姆瑞

en: Through understanding the shards, he became one with them.
zh: 通过理解碎片，他与它们合而为一。

en:
Bound in chains, forever linked to the
hatred they held onto in life.
zh:
被锁链束缚，永远连着
他们生前紧抓不放的仇恨。

en: Boundless ambition, beyond death, beyond reality.
zh: 无尽野心，超越死亡，超越现实。

en: Their fingers sift though every idea that was, is, or ever will be.
zh: 她们的手指筛过曾有、现有、或将有的每一个念头。

en: As if he needed an excuse to hunt monsters.
zh: 好像他还需要借口去猎怪似的。

en:
"Seek not outside you, Logos is within."
-- Treasure case inscription
zh:
「勿向外求，逻各斯在内。」
——宝匣铭文

en: "That's a beautiful pendant. Such a shame you won't be needing it anymore."
zh: 「多漂亮的吊坠。可惜你再也用不上了。」

en: He doesn't always hunt monsters, but when he does, he hangs them on the wall.
zh: 他不总是猎怪，但一旦猎到，就会挂在墙上。

en: "The sudden appearance of these shards is troubling.  We must discover their true nature."
zh: 「这些碎片突然出现令人不安。我们必须查明其真正本质。」

en: Their love for the light leads them where it is needed most.
zh: 对光明的爱把他们带到最需要光明之处。

en:
Divine incarnations of concepts and emotions,
the Askara are impossible creatures.
zh:
概念与情感的神圣化身，
阿斯卡拉是不可能的存在。

en: "He cannot hide from me, who has seen what lies beyond the last horizon." -- Emri
zh: 「他无法躲过我——我已见过最后地平线之外的景象。」——艾姆瑞

en: "He cannot hide from me, who has seen what lies beyond the last horizon." -- Emri
zh: 「他无法躲过我——我已见过最后地平线之外的景象。」——艾姆瑞

en: The most fearless in a society that values fearlessness, the scouts lead the charge, and all others follow.
zh: 在珍视无畏的社会中最无畏者，斥候冲锋在前，众人跟随。

en: As they honor their losses, the Arha remember that true nobility lies in sacrifice for a greater cause.
zh: 亚哈在纪念损失时记得：真正的高贵在于为更大事业牺牲。

en: "I contemplated for a hundred years a single blade of grass. I made it my entire world, my only adversary. Then, I cut it down."
zh: 「我用一百年思索一根草叶。它成了我的整个世界、唯一对手。然后，我斩断了它。」

en: Their poisons are the preferred of Black Watch assassins.
zh: 她们的毒素是黑卫刺客的首选。

en: Even the forest needs hope in the absence of light.
zh: 即便是森林，在缺光时也需要希望。

en: "Even the largest forest starts with but a single seed." -Stone Circle Invocation
zh: 「再大的森林也始于一粒种子。」——石环祈咒

en: Plants teach us that life will always begin again.
zh: 植物教导我们：生命总会重新开始。

en: When Verdagris awakens, so do the hatchling.
zh: 当维达格里斯苏醒，幼雏亦然。

en: A sword's strength comes as much from the bearer as it does the metal.
zh: 剑的力量既来自金属，也来自持剑之人。

en: All who see him have no choice but to follow.
zh: 凡看见他的人，别无选择，只能跟随。

en: Every kill brings him closer to redeeming his fallen brethren.
zh: 每一次击杀都让他更接近救赎陨落的同袍。

en:
"Hopefully this one doesn't blow up, I just grew my
eyebrows back." - Emma Ironheart
zh: 「真好奇这玩意儿能砸出多大坑。」——艾玛·铁心

en: The Black Watch and the Templars found a common language in battle.
zh: 黑卫与圣殿武士在战斗中找到了共同语言。

en:
The initiation is as harsh as the lands
from which they hail from.
zh:
入会仪式一如他们来自的土地
那般严酷。

en: A ravenous appetite for human emotion.
zh: 对人类情感有着贪婪的食欲。

en: A ravenous appetite for human emotion.
zh: 对人类情感有着贪婪的食欲。

en: Most are driven mad by the call of the void. Those already mad hear only wardrums.
zh: 多数人被虚空的召唤逼疯。本已疯狂者只听见战鼓。

en: Those at the edge of oblivion feel its pull most.
zh: 立于湮灭边缘者，感受其牵引最深。

en: Even the druids have forgotten the tongue he was named in.
zh: 连德鲁伊也忘了他得名所自的语言。

en: Denizens of Vigil lock their doors at the first scream of the night, clinging to the false hope that it will save them.
zh: 夜中第一声尖叫响起，祈夜居民便锁上门，紧抓那虚假的希望：门能救他们。

en:
Bark split flesh as
muscle hardened to wood.
A wish granted is a dream destroyed.
zh: 爱是一场梦。爱是一场梦魇。

en: You may delay, but time will not.
Water teaches us that change is inevitable.
zh: 水教导我们：变化不可避免。

en:
TOTAL crew - 23
10 wheelmen, 12 operators,1 certified barrel technician
zh:
编制 23 人
10 名驾驶员，12 名操作员，1 名持证炮管技师

en: The maelstrom surrounding him is matched only by the calm within him.
zh: 环绕他的漩涡，唯有他内心的平静可与之匹敌。

en: Victory comes at a cost, but it is cheaper than defeat.
zh: 胜利有代价，但比失败便宜。

en: Nairi spoke to the sentries, "Wear your armor with pride, and know that the forest defends you as you defend it."
zh: 奈瑞对哨兵说：「自豪地穿上你的铠甲，并知道：森林守护你，正如你守护森林。」

en: With great power comes a great hunger for more.
zh: 强大的力量伴随更强的渴求。

en: We don't need no water, let this wildfire burn.
zh: 我们不需要水，就让野火燃烧。

en: The druids admired the monks' resourcefulness and ingenuity. The monks admired the druids' embrace of the unknown.
zh: 德鲁伊钦佩僧侣的机巧与创见。僧侣钦佩德鲁伊对未知的拥抱。

en: The dark beasts shriek through the night sky, providing new nightmares for a new world.
zh: 黑暗兽群划破夜空尖叫，为新世界带来新噩梦。

en:
"There's a lot more than a storm coming."
-Oziah
zh:
「要来的远不止一场风暴。」
——奥齐亚

en: You will know your calling when you howl at the moon and her children howl back.
zh: 当你对月嚎叫，而她的孩子回应时，你便知道自己的召唤。

en: "You guys might not know this, but I consider myself a bit of a loner."
zh: 「你们或许不知道，但我自认有点独行。」

en: They would be more helpful if they weren't nuts
zh: 要不是疯疯癫癫，它们会更有用

en: They would be more helpful if they weren't nuts
zh: 要不是疯疯癫癫，它们会更有用

en:
They say every word Xeron utters
costs a thousand lives.
zh:
据说泽伦每说一个字
就付出上千条性命。

en: He's always happy to help, For a price.
From there come the dews that drop in the dells. It stands forever green over Aiyana's wells.
zh: 露水自彼处落入幽谷。它永绿屹立，覆于艾雅娜之井上。

en: As it grows, so too does the power of its wielder.
zh: 它生长时，持有者的力量亦然。

en: Energy source detected. Calculating life expectancy...
zh: 侦测到能源。正在计算预期寿命……

en: Forces of nature are neither good or bad, but they are capable of creating or destroying all the same.
zh: 自然之力无关善恶，却同样能创造或毁灭。

en: The universe began with a big bang, but the monks felt there was room for improvement
zh: 宇宙始于大爆炸，但僧侣觉得还有改进空间

en:
Zinta reached into the
Void and from it pulled daggers.
zh: 辛塔探入虚空，从中抽出匕首。

en: As many ways to die, as there are dreams to be dreamt.
zh: 死法之多，恰如梦境之多。

zh: ${LABEL_TROPHY_ONGOING} 每回合一次，获得灵魂宝石.

zh: ${LABEL_TROPHY} 放逐此 以获得灵魂宝石.

zh: ${LABEL_TROPHY} 你可以放逐此牌以获得${ICON_ENERGY1}.

zh: ${LABEL_TROPHY} 你可以放逐此牌以 抽两张牌.

zh: ${LABEL_TROPHY} 你可以放逐此牌以获得${ICON_ENERGY2}.
